# P12 · Officer views, funnel, roles and visit brief: v3 carry-over items

Created 2026-10-19 by the kit v3 migration (`docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`). Step B of the protocol merges these into the phase's full task list.

## v3 carry-over (added 2026-10-19, from `docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`)

- [ ] Roles coach and programme officer (assigned with consent, one person may hold both); weekly batch with item age and minutes against the 30-minute cap; nothing auto-approves.
- [ ] Funnel Delivered (system) -> Tried (self-report) -> Practised (system) -> Changed (next check); every number has its denominator and source label; "awaiting next check" until then; median teacher minutes beside it; suppression below 5 classes.
- [ ] CRC visit brief: only the track's error in plain words, the current lesson, one thing to look for, one question; no numbers about her class; only for teachers who opted in.
- [ ] Judge mode "Advance to Term 2" fills the funnel's Changed step.

- [ ] Content past 7 days without a decision shows the cohort "waiting for review" in place of the lesson (nothing auto-approves).
- [ ] The visit-brief opt-in is asked in the T4 flow (P10); the brief excludes teachers without it. Test first: a teacher without the opt-in is excluded.
- [ ] Docs `docs/roles.md` (who can hold each role, the weekly batch, the caps); `docs/judge-test-script.md` final.
- [ ] Gate 2 wording: every step in the video storyboard, bot flows and web screens alike, on the low-end phone; after "Advance to Term 2" the funnel and verdict render from computed data with source labels.
- [ ] 20 Oct brief: "Posts and replies" in the funnel as a system-labelled engagement count (never adoption); the mentor and coach pages in the Gate 2 storyboard check.
